name: 街头运动馆

parameters.prompt: One complete stylized miniature cyberpunk object, faithfully reconstruct the supplied image. A compact street sports hall: broad gently arched graphite roof, large double entrance, warm windows, robust cyan structural ribs, small abstract ball emblem, no court or attached ground. Preserve silhouette, complete front/back/sides, connected solid shapes, clean textured metal, warm windows, colored trim. No background, ground plate, text, smoke, bloom halo, floating lights or baked shadows. Render-time lights will be added separately.

imageProvider: project configured OpenAI-compatible gpt-image-2 via bundled imagegen CLI
adoption: adopted after front/side/rear inspection; scene integration validated separately

visualReview.notes: 拱顶、球形标记和门框完整；两端造型近似，对称门面可接受。
